scope: One complete Windows host-memory acquisition operation; no Codex build, scheduler admission/controller integration, production source edit or workflow edit.

contract.observations: Sequential, not atomic. Actual pagefile occupancy only; no inferred swap capacity from commit counters. Missing PDH map member is failure, present zero is success. Return only after every acquisition, validation and owned-handle cleanup succeeds.
contract.platform: 64-bit Windows only; other environments rejected with UnsupportedOperationException.
native_operations: K32GetPerformanceInfo: PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION size104 alignment8; PhysicalTotal32 PhysicalAvailable40 PageSize80; exact page-to-byte multiplication
CreateMemoryResourceNotification(0), QueryMemoryResourceNotification and CloseHandle with GetLastError captured and read only on failure
OSHI PerfCounterQueryFFM.queryValuesFromPDH(PagingFile.PagingPercentProperty.class,"Paging File") map PERCENTUSAGE raw used pages
contract.cleanup: Notification handle enters try-with-resources immediately; it closes before its enclosing native arena. Close failure prevents success, and a simultaneous original failure retains its close failure as suppressed.

selection.contract: Standalone WindowsMemory.read complete sequential total/available/actual-pagefile-occupancy/low-memory sample; all acquisition and cleanup must succeed.
selection.invariant: A successful present zero/false is data; unavailable or invalid acquisition fails without producing a Sample. macOS reader is analogous; commit charge is dissimilar and excluded from actual occupancy.
